mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_record ( audit_no, audit_type, business_id, applicant_id, title, content, attachments, current_status, priority, submit_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{auditNo}, #{auditType}, #{businessId}, #{applicantId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{attachments}, #{currentStatus}, #{priority}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT ar.id AS reportId, ar.audit_no AS reportNo, ar.business_id AS stationId, pcs.name AS stationName, CASE ar.audit_type WHEN 2 THEN 0 -- audit_type=2(充电桩投诉) -> reportType=0(举报) WHEN 3 THEN 1 -- audit_type=3(充电桩故障) -> reportType=1(故障) ELSE NULL END AS reportType, ar.title, ar.current_status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(ar.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM audit_record ar LEFT JOIN private_charge_station pcs ON ar.business_id = pcs.id WHERE ar.applicant_id = #{applicantId} AND ar.is_deleted = 0 AND (ar.audit_type = 2 OR ar.audit_type = 3) -- 只查询充电桩投诉和故障记录
AND ar.audit_type = CASE #{reportType} WHEN 0 THEN 2 -- reportType=0(举报) -> audit_type=2(充电桩投诉) WHEN 1 THEN 3 -- reportType=1(故障) -> audit_type=3(充电桩故障) END
AND ar.current_status = #{status}
ORDER BY ar.create_time DESC

SELECT ar.id AS reportId, ar.audit_no AS reportNo, CASE ar.audit_type WHEN 2 THEN 0 -- audit_type=2(充电桩投诉) -> reportType=0(举报/投诉) WHEN 3 THEN 1 -- audit_type=3(充电桩故障) -> reportType=1(故障) ELSE NULL END AS reportType, ar.business_id AS stationId, ar.applicant_id AS userId, ar.title, ar.content, ar.attachments, ar.current_status AS status, ar.current_admin_id AS adminId, ar.priority, DATE_FORMAT(ar.submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS submitTime, DATE_FORMAT(ar.finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finishTime, ar.final_opinion AS finalOpinion, ar.reject_reason AS rejectReason, DATE_FORMAT(ar.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(ar.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM audit_record ar WHERE ar.id = #{reportId} AND ar.is_deleted = 0 AND (ar.audit_type = 2 OR ar.audit_type = 3) -- 只查询充电桩投诉和故障记录
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_record SET current_status = 5, -- 5=已撤回 update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{reportId} AND applicant_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (audit_type = 2 OR audit_type = 3) -- 只更新充电桩投诉和故障记录
